data.desc: Lanvin Group is a leading global luxury fashion group headquartered in Shanghai, China, and Milan, Italy, managing iconic brands worldwide including Lanvin, Wolford, Sergio Rossi and St. John Knits. Leveraging its unique strategic alliances with industry-leading partners in the luxury fashion sector and its access to the fastest-growing luxury fashion markets, Lanvin Group strives to expand the global footprint of its portfolio brands and achieve sustainable growth through strategic investment and extensive operational know-how. Lanvin Group's ordinary shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol 'LANV'.
